title: Veterinary and Biomedical Sciences, B.S. (College of Agricultural Sciences)
notes: University Park. Major code VBS (distinct from the VBSC department prefix) chosen for consistency with this session's other VBSC-heavy majors. Extended vbsc_catalog.json (already started for Immunology and Infectious Disease / Pharmacology and Toxicology) with VBSC 421 and VBSC 403. VBSC 403 has an enforced concurrent requirement on ANSC 301, which is completed a full year earlier here, easily satisfied. 400-level 'Supporting Course' pools (9 credits total per the bulletin) and generic 'Elective' pools are modeled generically, same convention as CMPSC's own open pools. Post-rescrape real gap found, superseding the prior note about picking the CHEM 210/212/BMB 401 track: CHEM 110 has a real, literal 'MATH 22' prereq (not MATH 140/141), which itself chains through MATH 21 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 3, none of which were scheduled -- and MICRB 201 needs CHEM 110 specifically (no alternative), so that chain is unavoidable and was added (Semesters 1-4). But the CHEM 210 -> CHEM 212 -> BMB 401 route this chain feeds is too slow to reach BMB 401 within 8 terms (MATH 3 through BMB 401 is a 9-term serial dependency). The 'CHEM 210 (or 202)'/'CHEM 212 (or 203)'/'BMB 401 (or 211)'/'BMB 402 (or 221)' items already in this plan have real, faster alternatives: CHEM 202 (needs only CHEM 101/106/110/110H/130) and CHEM 203 (needs only CHEM 202) reach BMB 211 (needs CHEM 202/210/210H) and then BMB 221 (needs BMB 211) years sooner. Added CHEM 130 (needs only MATH 21 or MATH 32 -- no MATH 22 required) as a fast on-ramp to CHEM 202 (Semester 3); the engine's own 'first eligible option wins' scan then naturally resolves those four pool items onto the fast track once simulated, no forced course-list edit needed. Trimmed five generic 'Elective'/'Supporting Course' filler slots (Semesters 6-8) to keep the plan's real total credits from growing enough to push past 8 terms. Bulletin cross-check (bulletin-only -- the department's own VBS handbook PDF is gated behind PSU's Microsoft SSO login, only the public bulletin was verifiable) found 3 real gaps: (1) VBSC 300 (Veterinary Medical Terminology and Diagnostics, 3cr, a 'Prescribed Courses: Require a grade of C or better' item) was missing from the plan entirely -- added Semester 4 (its real prereq is BIOL 110 AND CHEM 110 AND CHEM 111, all completed by end of Semester 3). (2) The real biochemistry bundle is 'BMB 211 & BMB 212 & BMB 221' OR 'BMB 401 & BMB 402' (6 credits, 3 courses each track) -- this plan's fast track only had BMB 211 and BMB 221, missing the 1cr paired lab BMB 212; added alongside BMB 211 in Semester 5. (3) 'BA 100 (or ECON 14/102/104, AGBM 101)' in Semester 2 didn't correspond to any real VBS major requirement -- the full 'Requirements for the Major' table has no economics/business course anywhere in it (likely an accidental carry-over from a different major's AGBM 101/ECON 102 requirement); removed.
